CustomField.description:
Does the commercial segment and area code or team code matches the running user?
Used in My Teams Referrals Report
CustomField.formula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial Opportunity', TEXT(Owner.Commercial_Segment__c) = TEXT($User.Commercial_Segment__c), OR( $User.Area_Code__c == Owner.Area_Code__c, $User.Team_Code__c = Owner.Team_Code__c ) )
CustomField.label: My team's referrer?
